title: Directed Multigraph (Port) Facade for NetworkX Parity
description: Implement PortDirectedGraph in mathematical/graph/port/directed/normal/rs/lib.rs — the NetworkX MultiDiGraph parity facade wrapping Storage<Ported, Directed>. Union of directed-specific semantics (DirectedGraph/DiGraph facade) and multi-edge semantics (PortUndirectedGraph/MultiGraph facade). Uses a lazily-created default_handle: BTreeMap<NodeId, HandleId> per node to route node-level edge ops through Storage's HandleId-based add_edge. Covers construction, node ops, multigraph edge ops (parallel edges, in/out edges, path/cycle/star), queries (successors/predecessors dedup, degree counting parallel edges, density), transforms (copy/subgraph/edge_subgraph/reverse/to_undirected with reciprocal semantics/to_simple collapsing parallel edges), attributes, and self-loops. Implements GraphView/AttrView/EdgeWeights by delegation. Sole owned file: mathematical/graph/port/directed/normal/rs/lib.rs — no other files touched, no use of the empty stub algorithm-domain crates.
